title: Klint Kubiak: Ideally, you don't want a rookie QB to start from Day 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: Ideally, you don't want a rookie QB to start from Day 1
sources.description: While all indications are that the Raiders will select Fernando Mendoza next month, Las Vegas' HC said Tuesday he'd prefer to have a veteran for a rookie QB to learn behind.
